attempted_claim: Let S_4 be the closed orientable surface of genus 4, I_4 its Torelli group, H = H_1(S_4;Q) with Sp(8,Q)-action, c: ∧^2 H^1(I_4;Q) -> H^2(I_4;Q) the cup-product map with H^1(I_4;Q) dual to the first Johnson image, and A_4 the explicit finite set of second-homology abelian cycles obtained from commutators of configuration-carried genus-1 bounding-pair maps on a fixed standard chain-fan configuration. Let G_4 be the preimage in Mod(S_4) of a stated principal congruence subgroup of Sp(8,Z) and use H^2(G_4;Q) restriction to test for missing classes. Decide whether c together with A_4 generates H^2(I_4;Q) as an Sp(8,Q)-module, i.e. whether every rational second-cohomology class is an Sp-translate combination of cup products of Johnson-dual classes plus the stated abelian cycles. A complete answer either proves this module generation (closing the quadratic Johnson-Lie generation threshold) or exhibits an Sp(8,Q)-isotypic component of H^2(I_4;Q) containing no nonzero cup-product or A_4 class; dimension lower bounds alone do not count.
decisive_failure: Finite-dimensionality and algebraicity of H^2(I_4;Q) are open at genus 4, since Minahan-Putman cover only g>=5/g>=6 and Kupers-Randal-Williams only g>=12; Hain allows unknown cubic relations for 3<=g<6. The G_4 invariant-sector candidate could not be certified nonzero or A_4-orthogonal, and dimension-only arguments were excluded by the topic. No computation beyond literature verification was possible.
